blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY— Naga City secured its conversion into a highly urbanized city (HUC) after the “yes” vote prevailed in a plebiscite on Saturday (Nov. 21), garnering 30,538 votes against 6,648 for no. All 232 clustered precincts completed their canvassing, with 37,247 of the city’s 113,259 registered voters casting their ballots. Naga City Commission on Elections (Comelec) Officer Atty. Maico Julia announced the results on Saturday night.
